profile.headline: Sr Principal Software Engineer at Yahoo!
profile.summary: Sr Principal Software Engineer for Yahoo!, with over 20+ years of experience in software architecting and developing large scale, high performance Java applications, with extensive experience building high quality and scalable Java based server solutions.  Experience in software architecture, application code assessment and deployment procedures for a large-scale applications. Specialize in Java application performance and stability problem detection. Have a successful track record in leading and delivering projects given demanding timelines utilizing Agile methodologies and continuous integration.  Possess excellent leadership, communication and interpersonal skills.  Self-motivated, quick learner, energetic, and task oriented professional with creativity ability to solve problems.

projects.title: AMP HTML Java Validator
projects.description: AMP HTML Validator takes input of HTML text and parses the text tag by tag, running the ruleset against every tag. Resultant from this process is validity of the input text and the errors generated while parsing.
